items.text: To develop creativity skills, practise generating many ideas, set small constraints, combine unrelated things, make rough versions quickly and collect feedback, because creativity grows from regular making rather than waiting for inspiration.
Make something small every day, share it for feedback and keep a record of ideas and what you built from them.
Judge them by what you make and share, not by certificates.
